scope: Rank-16 target-A DROID View LoRA training and three-episode heldout generation
summary: The 91-episode rank-16 LoRA completed two epochs and generated three genuine heldout exterior-view candidates, but identity and motion gates reject promotion; the outputs remain explicitly labeled candidates.
evidence: Training completed 182/182 steps on physical A800 GPU 6 at learning rate 3e-5 with seed 20260811.
The selected epoch-1 checkpoint is 21,908,240 bytes with SHA-256 a633babf226309c8e05b4357295d9eeeb5797d3042a503962c1dbfb396271e9f.
Heldout generations for episodes 21/60/77 record real_target_passed_to_model=false and use the same 15-step inference recipe.
Aggregate full-frame SSIM is 0.520788, subject-ROI SSIM 0.376567, subject edge F1 0.619882, motion correlation -0.262506, and static-anchor gain -0.342496.
Episode 77 passes full-frame and subject appearance gates at 0.714907/0.511981, but fails motion correlation and static-anchor gain.
Every example fails at least one strict gate, so evaluation status is PARTIAL and the labeled demo says CANDIDATE / NOT ACCEPTED.
lessons: More paired episodes substantially improve exterior-view appearance over the 12-episode smoke model, but raw wrist-frame VACE control still leaks spatial structure and does not learn reliable cross-view motion.
A one-frame exterior anchor can stabilize some scenes without proving temporal viewpoint transfer.
limitations: The current candidates are 17 frames at 8 FPS and are not accepted as a subject-consistent viewpoint-generalization capability.
Metrics use deterministic motion-derived ROIs rather than semantic robot segmentation or 3D geometry.
next_actions: Evaluate multi-temporal training data and reject any route that cannot beat the static-anchor baseline on all three episodes.
